profile.name: Akhil Pandey
profile.tagline: Software Developer | Python & FastAPI | Workflow Automation
profile.shortBio: MCA graduate with 2+ years of professional experience in IT, process automation, and scalable backend architecture. Specialized in Python, FastAPI, and enterprise workflows.
profile.about: I am a backend-oriented Software Developer with hands-on expertise in architecting high-performance REST APIs, automating mission-critical business workflows (n8n, Make.com, Zapier), and managing structured database environments. Experienced at coordinating with cross-functional teams and clients, resolving queries with agility, and deploying live production services on Render and Docker.

strengths.desc: Proven track record assigning tasks, tracking progress, and delivering milestones on time. Served as Vice President of the Association of MCA Students.

strengths.title: Public Dealing & Query Resolution
strengths.desc: Experienced in interacting professionally with visitors, clients, and team members; understanding operational bottlenecks and resolving them swiftly.

strengths.title: Computer Proficiency & Work Ethic
strengths.desc: Strong grip on data systems, clean validation, audit-ready reporting, and modern DevOps tools. Punctual, dependable, and highly adaptable.

projects.title: AutomateX API Gateway & Workflow Orchestrator
projects.description: High-throughput asynchronous REST API built with FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and Redis. Features automated webhook ingestion, retry mechanisms, and rate-limited endpoints. Deployed live on Render.

projects.title: AI-Powered Customer CRM & Automated Leads Engine
projects.description: Custom CRM engine engineered for rapid client query intake, automated email alerts, and multi-step webhook sync between forms, database, and notification channels. Hosted live on Render.

projects.title: Smart Document Data Extraction & OCR Pipeline
projects.description: Automated OCR extraction pipeline that reads invoices and vouchers, executes strict mathematical validation rules, and saves structured records into databases.

projects.title: Scalable Authentication & Microservices Boilerplate
projects.description: Production-ready template for microservices architecture featuring JWT authentication, role-based access control (RBAC), rate-limiting middleware, and health-check monitoring.

projects.title: RPA Financial Reconciliation & Reporting Bot
projects.description: Automated desktop & web scraping bot to match bank receipts with internal ledger records, generating audit-ready Excel reports and notifying stakeholders on Slack/Email.

points: Architecting robust backend APIs using Python (FastAPI & Django); coordinating closely with cross-functional teams and clients to resolve queries and deliver milestones on time.
Automating routine office workflows using Make.com, Zapier, and N8N, slashing manual operational effort and error rates.
Performing strict data validation and consistency checks; identifying root causes of data issues and maintaining audit-ready records and reports.
Interacted directly with enterprise clients to map business workflows and customized CRM software matching exact day-to-day operational requirements.
Maintained structured schemas, rigorous validation rules, and automated reporting formats to keep enterprise records clean and audit-ready.
Significantly improved turnaround time of backend data processes through proactive coordination, query optimization, and follow-ups.
Identified repetitive manual tasks in office workflows and engineered automated RPA bots, vastly enhancing operational throughput.
Collaborated with senior engineers to track, benchmark, and report runtime performance gains of automated processes.
